ModMetaData.name: ShapeShifter Framework
ModMetaData.author: TRIBeagle
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]Shapeshifter Framework[/h1]
A universal shapeshifting framework for RimWorld 1.6. Modders can define custom transformation forms using [b]XML only[/b] — no C# required.
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*] Timed or permanent forms with voluntary revert, sustain conditions, and multi-stage chains [*] Full visual control: body/head/hair/tattoo replace/hide, gender textures, render nodes, shaders [*] Custom verbs and tools with per-verb auto-attack toggle gizmos [*] Equipment handling: keep/inventory/drop per slot, equipment lock, spawn gear on transform [*] VFX and sound: enter/exit effects, ambient flecks, voice/blood/flesh override [*] Multiple trigger methods: ability, drug, scroll, projectile, equipment grant, gene, auto-shift [*] Ideology integration: shapeshift precepts with mood/opinion/social effects [*] Anomaly DLC: per-form mutant eligibility filtering [/list]
[h2]For Modders[/h2] Define a [b]ShapeshiftFormDef[/b] in XML, link it to a HediffDef, and choose a trigger method. See the [url=https://github.com/TRIBeagle/Shapeshifter-Framework/blob/main/FORMDEF_GUIDE_EN.md]FormDef Creation Guide[/url] for the full field reference.
[h2]Compatibility[/h2] [list] [*] HAR (Humanoid Alien Races) — body addon scaling [*] Facial Animation — face component backup/restore [*] Simple Sidearms — weapon memory backup/restore [*] Pocket Sand — gizmo filtering on transform [*] Combat Extended — compatible via XPath patches (see guide) [*] Pawnmorpher — [b]Incompatible[/b] (overlapping transformation systems) [/list]
